description: Logs recording activities, exceptions, faults, and security events are not produced and retained.
applicability: Applies to organizations that do not implement comprehensive logging of user activities, administrative actions, system events, security events, exceptions, and faults, or fail to retain logs for appropriate periods to support incident detection, investigation, and compliance.

metadata.detection_notes: Review logging configurations, log collection and aggregation, log retention policies, protection of log integrity, logging coverage (applications, systems, network devices, security tools), and compliance with regulatory logging requirements.
